translation: Look, me ⟨dey⟩ do ⟨את⟩ all di people wey dey oppress you for dat time; and I go save ⟨את⟩ di lame one, and di one wey dem drive away I go gather, and I go make dem for praise and for name inside all di earth, di shame wey dey shame dem.
